fields.description: D19 §4h. FORMULA. The $/W the company keeps before commission, chosen by deal type × finance source: External+LightReach 1.75, External+other 1.85, Internal+LightReach 2.10, Internal+other 2.20. Internal means the sales-company field reads "Harmon Solar".

fields.label: Total Adder Price
fields.description: D19 §4h. FORMULA. Every priced adder at PRICE: flat adders at Price × Qty, per-watt adders at Price × Watts × Qty, NS blocks 1-5 at their marked-up total. Referral included.

fields.label: Commission Total
fields.description: D19 §4h. FORMULA, and THE number the budget engine reads for the rep commission. Routed to SLPC · LABOR · SALESCOMM (burdened) on an internal deal, or SLPC OUT · OTHER · M1&M2COM (not burdened) on an external one, by sales company alone.

fields.label: Commission Total $/W
fields.description: D19 §4h. FORMULA. Commission Total ÷ watts — the derived REP rate. NOT the same as the calc output Commission_PPW__c, which is every commission (rep + management + setter + burden) ÷ watts.

fields.label: 3rd Party Rep Commission
fields.description: 3rd Party Rep Commission $/W × Watts. ⚠ MEANING CHANGED IN v2 — this is the THIRD-PARTY amount only (posts to SLPC OUT · OTHER · M1&M2COM and is NOT burdened). On an internal deal it is 0 and the commission is in Internal Rep Commission.

fields.label: Internal Rep Commission
fields.description: Written by the budget calc engine — never edited from the portal. Internal Rep Commission $/W × Watts → SLPC · LABOR · SALESCOMM. Burdened (75%).

fields.label: Sales Manager Commission (component)
fields.description: Sales Manager Commission $/W × Watts. A COMPONENT of Management Commission (SLMC) — stored separately only because the Acumatica attribute sync splits MGRCOM* back out (D10).

fields.label: Overhead Commission (component)
fields.description: Overhead Commission $/W × Watts. A COMPONENT of Management Commission (SLMC) — stored separately only because the Acumatica attribute sync splits MGMTOR* back out (D10).

fields.label: Management Commission (SLMC)
fields.description: Written by the budget calc engine — never edited from the portal. (Sales Manager $/W + Overhead $/W) × Watts — the single SLMC · LABOR · SALESCOMM line that actually posts to Acumatica (D10).

fields.label: Setter Commission (Applied)
fields.description: Written by the budget calc engine — never edited from the portal. What the setter rule actually PAID on this job → APPT COM (D17). 0 when the linked Customer has no Setter.

fields.label: Commission Subtotal
fields.description: 3rd Party Rep + Internal Rep + Management (SLMC) + Setter (applied). The Sales Manager and Overhead components are inside Management and are NOT counted again.

fields.label: Commission Burden
fields.description: (Internal Rep + Management + Setter) × Commission Burden Rate. ⚠ Third-party rep commission is NOT burdened (D9).

fields.label: Total Commissions
fields.description: Commission_Subtotal__c + Commission_Burden_Amt__c

fields.label: Commission $/W
fields.description: Total_Commissions__c ÷ Watts

fields.label: Commission Deal Type

fields.label: Cost $/W (With Commission)
fields.description: Cost_PPW__c + Commission_PPW__c

fields.label: GENA Hours
fields.description: Audit_Hours__c + QA_Commissioning_Hours__c

fields.label: S1 Hours
fields.description: S1 Labor ÷ Blended_Labor_Rate__c (= 2/3 of module hours)

fields.label: S2 Hours
fields.description: S2 Labor ÷ Blended_Labor_Rate__c (= 1/3 of module hours)

fields.label: S3 Hours
fields.description: Battery_Install_Hours__c + Adder_Hours_Total__c

fields.label: Total Job Hours
fields.description: GENA + S1 + S2 + S3 hours

fields.label: DC Rebate Amount
fields.description: Written by the budget calc engine — never edited from the portal. $0.45 × Watts when Domestic Content is affirmative, else 0 (D2). A third INCOME line (DCREBATE) on RSDC projects; it raises Balance of Revenue and GP.

fields.label: Balance of Revenue
fields.description: Contract Amount + DC Rebate − Dealer Fee − Total Commissions (sheet N10).

fields.label: Total Labor & Burden
fields.description: Total Labor Budget + Total Labor Burden Budget (sheet N12). This is the labor figure the GP calculation nets.

fields.label: Total Other (GP Summary)
fields.description: Written by the budget calc engine — never edited from the portal. Sheet N13 = Total Other Budget (GENO) + Engineer Stamps + Subcontractor + Software + Referral. THIS is the “other” figure the GP calculation nets.

fields.label: GP Dollars
fields.description: Balance of Revenue − Total Material − Total Labor & Burden − Total Other (GP Summary) (sheet N14).

fields.label: GP % (With Commissions)
fields.description: GP_Dollars__c ÷ Contract_Amount__c

fields.label: GP % (No Commissions)
fields.description: GP_Dollars__c ÷ Balance_of_Revenue__c

fields.label: Budget Last Calculated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful budget calculation by the budget Lambda.

fields.label: Budget Calc Status
fields.description: Set to Pending by the trigger Flow when a recalc is requested; set to Calculated or Error by the budget Lambda.

fields.label: Budget Calc Error
fields.description: Last calculation error message, if any. Cleared on success.

fields.label: Budget Finalized
fields.description: When checked, the budget is pushed to Acumatica ProjectBudget lines via the integration queue.

fields.label: Latest Budget File Path
fields.description: S3 key of the most recent budget workbook snapshot (SUNDIAL/{record_id}/...).

fields.label: Commission PO Status
fields.description: §4f. Written by the commission PO engine. None = nothing raised, which is CORRECT for an internal deal (commission is payroll, D16) and for a job with no third-party commission. Frozen = a released PO could not be changed and the difference belongs in M2 — expected, deliberately not filed under Failed.

fields.label: Commission PO M1 Number
fields.description: §4f. The Acumatica OrderNbr of the M1 commission purchase order — min(50% of commission, $2,500) to the third-party dealer. THE IDEMPOTENCY KEY. Text, not Number: Acumatica order numbers are zero-padded strings (016102) and a Number field drops the leading zero.

fields.label: Commission PO M1 Amount
fields.description: §4f. What the M1 purchase order was actually raised for. Redundant against Acumatica by design — it lets the portal show what was raised without a round trip, and makes "the commission has changed since we raised M1" answerable from the Salesforce record alone.

fields.label: Commission PO M1 Created
fields.description: §4f. When the M1 purchase order was RAISED. Stamped on creation only and never on a later update. NOT the milestone date — the site audit date the PO carries is Audit_Date_and_DateTime__c (D23).

fields.label: Commission PO M2 Number
fields.description: §4f. The Acumatica OrderNbr of the M2 commission purchase order — the balance of the dealer commission after M1. Also an idempotency key; also Text for the leading zero. M1 and M2 have their own fields because they are separate documents with separate lifecycles.

fields.label: Commission PO M2 Amount
fields.description: §4f. What the M2 purchase order was actually raised for. See Commission_PO_M1_Amount__c for why it is stored rather than read back from Acumatica.

fields.label: Commission PO M2 Created
fields.description: §4f. When the M2 purchase order was RAISED. Creation only, never updated. NOT the milestone date — the install date the PO carries is Scheduled_Install_Date__c (D23).

fields.label: Commission PO Error
fields.description: §4f. The refusal or failure message from the last commission PO run, CLEARED on a clean one. Where a frozen PO says which two amounts it is between, where an unmapped dealer names the CSV row it needs, and where a create that half-succeeded says so.

fields.label: Attribute Sync Status
fields.description: D-061. Written by the Acumatica attribute sync, from BOTH the budget push worker's Stage E and the attribute-only route. BLANK = never run here, which is why there is no "None". Nothing to Sync = it ran and the record had no populated values. UNVERIFIED IS NOT A FAILURE: Acumatica returns 200 and silently discards an AttributeID the project template does not define, so the write may have partly happened and was not confirmed. Failed = it did not happen.

fields.label: Attribute Synced At
fields.description: D-061. When the attributes were last known GOOD. Stamped on a successful sync and on "Nothing to Sync", but deliberately NOT moved on a failure or an unverified run — a stale record must not look fresh because we tried and could not. Read it together with Attribute_Sync_Status__c: a recent timestamp beside "Failed" means the failure came after a good run.

fields.label: Attribute Sync Error
fields.description: D-061. Why the last attribute sync failed or could not be verified, CLEARED on a clean run. This is where an attribute Acumatica accepted with a 200 and then discarded gets named — without it that outcome is invisible, because nothing about the response distinguishes "written" from "thrown away".

fields.label: Dealer
fields.description: The dealer that owns this project, set from the sales rep. Blank until a rep with a dealer is assigned.

fields.label: Number of Panels
fields.description: Stores the total number of solar panels included in the system.

fields.label: Created Date
fields.description: When the record was created (the original system's created date where one was migrated).

fields.label: Record ID
fields.description: The Salesforce record id (join key).
